text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: GYAAAAAAHH!!

A few weeks have passed since we swore
to run the Tiara route with everything we've got.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant*!
Aaaah, that's brutal...!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —No, not yettt!!

That side of her after the mock race was only seen that once,
and she continued to train diligently every single day.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, that wraps up today's menu.
Well thenâ

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Head on home already, Trainy!
I'm gonna run just a little bit more!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oraaaahh!!

"Even so,
the feelings she poured out back then couldn't have been a lie."

Right now, she is struggling with all her might
to become a strong and noble "Hishi Amazon."
choice_data_list: (What I can do for her right now is...)

text_block_list.text:
"In order to properly support her as a Trainer,
I decided to re-examine and study Hishi Amazon's
running style once again."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Whew! What a fine morning!
Alright, let's give it all we've got today too, Trainy!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Wait! Are you okay? You're completely
wobbling on your feet, aren't you?!
I hand Hishi Amazon the booklet I had prepared.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's this?
"Training Book for Hishi Amazon"?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "‘Maximizing Hishi Amazon's innate physical capabilities through training focused primarily on explosive power and strength enhancement’..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "To strengthen the quadriceps, sartorius, and adductor muscles, perform with repeatable load weights"—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Nutritional management based on sports nutrition science,
and fast-twitch muscle training on mountain trails that also doubles as a refresh"—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...I see... hmm... wow~!
Well, well... ahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't put that together even if I tried standing on my head.
Thanks a ton, Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: We're training with this starting today, no time to lose!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "—Now go get some sleep! I'm not letting you train looking like that!"

And so began our daily training routine,
training book in hand.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ROOOAAARGH!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Third lap complete...!
*pant*, *gasp*, *wheeze*!
choice_data_list: Hang in there, just one more rep!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Whoa, take this!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, I hate having to sit still!
I know eating right takes learning and all, but still!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...I don't know how you can just sit there
and read that mountain of text forever...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...!
Well, look at you talking big, Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Librarian
text_block_list.text: Please keep it quiet in the library.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ah, my bad...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oryaaaaa~h!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, huh? Where'd Trainer go?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!?
Whoa, whoa, you're wobbling all over the place! Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wait a sec, this is supposed to be training, right?
You should take the ropeway
and head up ahead of me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: I couldn't let anything happen to you
I can't let anything happen to you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...! Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you're an idiot too, ya know.
Come on, hop on my back! I'll carry ya there!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Just climbing it would be way too easy, after all.
This is just about right!
And so, our days of working hand-in-hand in training continued—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: HRAAAAAAAAAAA!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant, pant*!
Well, Trainy?! How's my time?!"

The numbers on the stopwatch in my hand
showed significant improvement compared to before.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hell yeahhh!

Without thinking, I wrote the time down huge on the record sheet.
If she keeps this up, she's sure to deliver great results!

Taking these recorded times into account,
I'll start designing a new training regimen right away.
choice_data_list: What we need to move on to the next stage is—

text_block_list.text:
I found myself locking eyes with Hishi Amazon,
who was staring intently in my direction.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no.
It's really nothing big.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well... I thought the Twinkle Series
was just a one-on-one duel for me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: It's a festival where I have the one-on-one showdowns I want, and take the wins for myself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Still... watching from the side, I can tell you're
just as hungry to snatch that victory.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, that's true.
—And Hishi Amazon smiled shyly.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "I realized that you, Trainer... were having a one-on-one showdown of your own."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Seeing my partner wolf down food beside me...
Well... it's not bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! What's with this mood, cut it out!
Now then, what were you saying about training!?
Just a little longer until the Oka Sho.
